text: RESULTS: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis: Large right ovarian mass with irregular borders and associated significant ascites; no distant metastatic lesions identified in the liver or peritoneum. speaker: Doctor
text:
The imaging confirms a large, heterogeneous right ovarian mass with irregular borders, significant ascites, and a right-sided pleural effusion compressing your lung, but no pulmonary nodules are present. Given these findings, have you noticed any bloating, early satiety, or urinary frequency in addition to your shortness of breath?

speaker: Doctor
text:
The lab results showing elevated LDH and HE4 alongside a normal CEA, combined with the imaging of a large, solid/cystic ovarian mass, ascites, and pleural effusion, are highly suggestive of an epithelial ovarian malignancy. Given your age and the specific tumor markers, do you have a family history of breast, ovarian, or colon cancer?
